name: central-icons
title: Central Icons
description: Browse, search and export all Central icons — copy or paste SVG, code snippets, or export SVG files.
author: tamino-martinius

commands.name: search-icons
commands.title: Search Icons
commands.description: Browse and search all Central icons and export them as SVG or code snippets.

preferences.name: licenseKey
preferences.title: License Key
preferences.description: Your Central Icons license key (XXXXXXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXXXXXXXXXX). Unlocks unlimited copies — without it, you get 10 free copies. Buy one at centralicons.com.

preferences.name: primaryAction
preferences.title: Primary Action
preferences.description: The action triggered when pressing Enter on an icon.

preferences.name: gridColumns
preferences.title: Grid Columns
preferences.description: Number of columns in the icon grid.

preferences.name: fill
preferences.title: Default Style
preferences.description: Icon style used when the extension launches (can be changed per session via the Style submenu).

preferences.name: stroke
preferences.title: Default Stroke Width
preferences.description: Stroke width used when the extension launches.

preferences.name: radius
preferences.title: Default Corner Radius
preferences.description: Corner radius used when the extension launches.

preferences.name: join
preferences.title: Default Line Join
preferences.description: Line join used when the extension launches.

preferences.name: masking
preferences.title: Default Masking
preferences.description: Masked icons render uniformly with semi-transparent colors (overlap-safe); raw keeps separate paths. Used when the extension launches.
